title: Protective enclosure
description: Pearl polymer shell, recessed identity panel and USB-C service opening.

title: Status light guide
description: Translucent guide carries the PCB status LED to the front indicator.

title: Perimeter gasket
description: Elastomer seal between the reusable cover and structural frame; sealing performance untested.

title: Main electronics
description: ESP32-S3 N16R8, ECG and EMG front ends, MPU6050, BME280, charging, conversion and local microSD storage.

title: Rechargeable cell
description: Protected pouch-cell envelope and keyed connection. Capacity awaits cell selection.

title: Inner support frame
description: Battery pocket, board supports, screw bosses and routed flex passage.

title: Flexible sensor interface
description: Polyimide substrate, copper routes, optical sensing and temperature interface. Contact placement is provisional.

title: Skin-side spacer
description: Compliant silicone carrier with optical and electrode apertures.

title: Electrodes and optical interface
description: Two ECG contacts, two EMG contacts, a BioZ contact and a temperature contact around the PPG window.

title: Replaceable adhesive
description: Die-cut attachment layer with sensing apertures. Material qualification is pending.

title: Peel-away release liner
description: Protects the adhesive before application. Remove before wear.
